assumptions: Element masses are the standard tables'; ProForma tags resolve to the modification masses named.
limits: A calculated mass, not a measured one; isotope distribution is isotope_envelope's question.
bio.jane/contract.question: What is this peptide's monoisotopic and average mass, and its m/z at each charge?

description: Monoisotopic and average mass of a peptide, and its m/z at each charge state (validated against pyteomics). Plain one-letter sequences also take an ion type (b, y, c, z, a, x and their neutral-loss forms); a ProForma peptidoform with modification tags, as masses or Unimod names and accessions (e.g. [TMT6plex]-PEPTM[Oxidation]IDE, M[UNIMOD:35], M[+15.994915]), is weighed monoisotopically with its modifications.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

charges.description: charge states to report m/z for (positive integers).

ionType.description: weigh the peptide as this ion; M is the intact molecule. Plain sequences only.

sequence.description: peptide: one-letter residues, optionally ProForma tags on residues and termini (a signed mass, a Unimod name, or UNIMOD:accession).

name: peptide_mass

average.description: neutral average mass (Da); null for a peptidoform with modification tags

mz.description: per charge: monoisotopic and average m/z
